review_corrections.scope: Spec 71 decision 4 and final Standards/Spec findings; no material safeguard downgrades.
review_corrections.heuristics: Pure word count, specialized completion/closeout wording, absent lexical phase labels, Retrospective eligibility/visit/timeline wording require independent review.
review_corrections.essential_evidence: Empty or malformed/placeholder text, invalid/missing citations, missing quantities, recognized conflicting phase-duration bindings, source polarity, protected safeguards and proven textless rendered pages retain essential repair.
review_corrections.ownership: Retrospective missing narrative facts belong to drafting; proven textless pages belong to rendering, never runtime.
review_corrections.equal_phase_durations: A correctly approved value on another recognized phase cannot establish reassignment when a phase label is unrecognized. Recognized phase/value disagreement or an explicitly unsupported phase assignment remains factual; actual missing quantities and units remain essential. Paired canonical ingestion negatives and an equal-duration actual ICF Desktop delivery cover the distinction.
